name: David Singleton
subject: Leadership Architecture, and the tough calls

beats.hook: Most call that a restructure. You wrote "something I call 'Leadership Architecture'", and leaders come to you once the calls get hard.
beats.identity: I find the ones who'd be ringing you. The last coach I did this for closed 6 of the 9 meetings I set up.
beats.offer: I've already got 10 names for you. Real people here, picked one at a time.
beats.cta: 15 minutes and they're yours the same day. I'll tell you why these 10 and not the other 40.
beats.ps: ps: no pitch deck behind this, and nothing to unsubscribe from.
